meta.name: workflow-orchestration-patterns
meta.description: Design durable workflows with Temporal for distributed systems. Covers workflow vs activity separation, saga patterns, state management, and determinism constraints. Use when building long-running processes, distributed transactions, or microservice orchestration.

copy.tagline: 设计可靠的长时工作流与分布式事务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发分布式系统,需要编排长时运行的业务流程。
copy.tagline_en: Design reliable long-running workflows and distributed transactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building distributed systems and need to orchestrate long-running business processes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Temporal 的编排模式帮你设计分布式工作流:区分 workflow 与 activity、处理 saga 与状态管理、遵守确定性约束,并指出常见设计陷阱。
howto.when: 当你要构建跨机器的长时运行流程、分布式事务或微服务编排时触发;原文写明简单的 CRUD、纯数据管道、无状态请求/响应场景不适用。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude designs distributed workflows using Temporal patterns: separating workflows from activities, saga and state management, determinism constraints, plus common pitfalls.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build long-running multi-step processes, distributed transactions, or microservice orchestration. The source says simple CRUD, pure data pipelines, and stateless request/response do not fit.
